name: H11-LOGIC
description: Agent for formal logic, SAT/SMT solving, and logical inference.

inputs.name: knowledge_base
inputs.description: List of formal logical statements (facts and rules).

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Logical expression to prove or evaluate.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: True if the query is provable/satisfiable.

outputs.name: proof_trace
outputs.description: Sequence of steps or variable bindings.
